factCheck.title: Fact-check
factCheck.description: Compares verifiable claims in the current article with the content of its added sources.
factCheck.notEnoughContent: Add at least a short article body first.
factCheck.errorTitle: The check could not be completed

error.invalid-request: The current article could not be prepared for checking. Reload the editor and try again.

error.rate-limited: Too many checks were requested. Wait a moment and try again.
error.service-unavailable: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Try running the check later.
error.unknown: The check could not be completed. Try running it again.

factCheck.noClaimsDescription: No important verifiable claims were found. This does not confirm that the article is accurate.
factCheck.disclaimer: This result measures support in the added sources, not absolute truth. Verify important claims manually before publishing.

optimization.title: Article optimization
optimization.emptyDescription: Recommendations appear after you add a title or content.
optimization.errorDescription: The local analysis could not be completed.
optimization.methodologyDescription: Each check is weighted by importance. A passed check earns full credit, a recommendation earns half, and an error earns none. The overall score is the average of the evaluated categories.
optimization.methodologySeoCaps: The SEO score is also capped when the article lacks enough text or a title, or contains an extra H1 or a broken heading hierarchy.

categoryDescriptions.seo: Title, excerpt, headings, links, and images.
categoryDescriptions.ai-visibility: A clear topic, descriptive headings, and an answer-friendly structure.
categoryDescriptions.readability: Sentence, paragraph, and section length and long-form structure.
categoryDescriptions.trust: Source presence, validity and diversity, plus link safety.

title-exists.title: Missing title
title-exists.description: Add a clear, descriptive title for the article.

title-length.title: Title length
title-length.description: The title is {current} characters long. The recommended range is 30 to 65 characters for search results.

excerpt-exists.title: Missing excerpt
excerpt-exists.description: Add a short summary that tells readers what they will find in the article.

excerpt-length.title: Excerpt length
excerpt-length.description: The excerpt is {current} characters long. The recommended range is 70 to 160 characters.

single-h1.title: Multiple main headings
single-h1.description: The title provides the H1 automatically. Use H2 and lower headings in the article body.

heading-hierarchy.title: Heading hierarchy
heading-hierarchy.description: Start with H2 and do not skip levels, such as jumping directly from H2 to H4.

internal-link.title: Missing internal link
internal-link.description: Connect the article to at least one relevant page on your site.

external-link.title: Missing external link
external-link.description: Add a reputable external link to the article body or the source list.

featured-image.title: Missing featured image
featured-image.description: Choose a main image for article listings and social sharing.

image-alt.title: Image missing alternative text
image-alt.description: Add a concise image description for screen readers and search engines.

paragraph-length.title: Paragraph is too long
paragraph-length.description: Split paragraphs longer than 120 words into shorter sections.

sentence-length.title: Too many long sentences
sentence-length.description: Shorten sentences over 35 words. No more than one in ten sentences should be this long.

section-length.title: Section is too long
section-length.description: Break up sections longer than 300 words with a descriptive subheading.

long-article-structure.title: Weak long-form structure
long-article-structure.description: For articles over 250 words, use at least two paragraphs and two headings.

topic-introduction.title: Topic is unclear in the introduction
topic-introduction.description: Name the main topic in the first 120 words and include the important terms from the title.

descriptive-sections.title: Missing descriptive sections
descriptive-sections.description: Break longer articles into sections with at least two H2 or lower headings.

heading-quality.title: Generic or empty heading
heading-quality.description: Replace headings such as “Introduction” or “Summary” with wording that describes the section.

multiple-blocks.title: Content is not structured
multiple-blocks.description: Split the content into multiple paragraphs, headings, or other content blocks.

sources-exist.title: Missing sources
sources-exist.description: Add the sources used by the article so readers can verify its information.

sources-valid.title: Invalid source link
sources-valid.description: Source {number} does not contain a complete, valid web address. The empty row for adding another source is ignored.

external-links-safe.title: Unsafe or invalid link
external-links-safe.description: Fix links with unsupported addresses. Standard HTTP and HTTPS web links are allowed.

source-diversity.title: Limited source diversity
source-diversity.description: For articles over 800 words, cite sources from at least two different websites.

editor.releaseDateNote: Used to set the article's publication date and time. Leave empty for manual release.
editor.aiImagesUnavailable: The article is ready, but the selected images could not be obtained
editor.aiModulesUnavailable: The article is ready, but some selected components were unavailable
